name: agent-wallet-codex
description: Non-custodial agent wallet toolkit: create wallets, send, receive, swap, bridge, sign, and deploy Solidity contracts across EVM and Bitcoin, straight to chain.

interface.shortDescription: Non-custodial on-chain wallet for agents (EVM and Bitcoin)
interface.longDescription: Create and import wallets, check balances, send native coin, ERC-20 and BTC, swap via DEX aggregators, bridge across chains, and author, deploy, verify, call, or write Solidity contracts. Keys stay on your machine, encrypted; transactions go straight to public RPC endpoints. Mainnet is denied until explicitly allowed.
defaultPrompt: Use the agent-wallet skill to create a wallet, check a balance, or send funds on-chain.
